description:
Implement a narrow BenchBox core updater. Poll the fork verified-delivery contract plus manual dispatch; compare eligible version to the core pin, download exact artifact, verify trusted producer origin/expected identities/hash, use the transactional adopter and open an ordinary allowed-path core PR. Core never discovers upstream, prepares source refreshes, merges fork PRs, repeats fork validation or receives fork-write credentials. Upstream/build/producer exceptions belong in the fork; core wrapper/install/adoption exceptions belong in core. Theseus reviews the actual consumer PR normally, with no external-source mode or second review job.

Keep at most one core adoption active, preserve green/armed work across newer deliveries, remember reverted forkSHA+wheelHash so a poll cannot undo rollback, and never override a human disarm/hold. Only documented trunk-red disarm/recovery may be re-armed automatically. Separate no-write candidate preparation from pinned trusted publisher/arming code; core App has contents+PR write, no statuses/checks/workflows write. App-created and App-armed merges must trigger ordinary PR and trunk CI. Keep existing pr-arm exact-head/threads/holds/trunk/duration/review controls. Default-off kill switch, no-write dry-run and idempotent interrupted publication/merge handling. No new service, fork source review, source reconstruction, alternate builder or hidden retry-until-green.

This item alone owns delivery-origin trust: core-reviewed configuration fixes producer repository/workflow path/ref/event, and the updater verifies canonical run/attempt/artifact identity and schema before supplying expected version/SHAs/hash to the adopter. A delivery record cannot change the trust root. Same-version/different-hash is a fork-owned exception, never a no-op skip. After producer recovery accept the new exact verified record for the same source/version/hash, not stale attempt bindings. Once a core PR contains the wheel bytes, expiry of the original payload download must not invalidate an otherwise verifiable receipt. Do not assume this requires a new Theseus API, reviewer or registry service.
